title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin bounces 2.4 percent to 64,350 dollars while fear and greed sits at extreme fear of 23. Asia buyers stepped in overnight, pushing price higher despite the bearish sentiment reading.

Hashrate remains firm at 819.9 EH/s. Mempool holds 92,000 transactions with fees at just 2 sat/vB, keeping the chain open for fast, cheap moves. Block 957,412 confirmed.

Watch volume today. If spot demand builds on this lift, the fear gauge can flip quickly. Low fees point to light congestion into the weeken
